content.text: Arrows move  Enter restart  B back

scripts.init:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
sceneState.snake = {{x=5, y=5}, {x=5, y=6}, {x=5, y=7}}
local function draw()
    local text = ""
    if sceneState.lost == 1 then text = "GAME OVER\n" end
    for y = 0, sceneState.gridHeight - 1 do
        for x = 0, sceneState.gridWidth - 1 do
            local char = "."
            if x == sceneState.targetX and y == sceneState.targetY then
                char = "*"
            else
                for _, part in ipairs(sceneState.snake) do
                    if part.x == x and part.y == y then
                        char = "O"
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            text = text .. char
        end
        text = text .. "\n"
    end
    sceneState.boardText = text
end
draw()
scripts.update:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
if sceneState.lost == 1 then return end
sceneState.dirX = sceneState.nextDirX
sceneState.dirY = sceneState.nextDirY
local head = sceneState.snake[1]
local nx = head.x + sceneState.dirX
local ny = head.y + sceneState.dirY

if nx < 0 or nx >= sceneState.gridWidth or ny < 0 or ny >= sceneState.gridHeight then
    sceneState.lost = 1
end

for _, part in ipairs(sceneState.snake) do
    if part.x == nx and part.y == ny then
        sceneState.lost = 1
    end
end

if sceneState.lost == 0 then
    table.insert(sceneState.snake, 1, {x=nx, y=ny})
    if nx == sceneState.targetX and ny == sceneState.targetY then
        sceneState.targetX = (nx + 5) % sceneState.gridWidth
        sceneState.targetY = (ny + 7) % sceneState.gridHeight
        sceneState.stepTime = math.max(0.1, sceneState.stepTime * 0.95)
    else
        table.remove(sceneState.snake)
    end
end

local text = ""
if sceneState.lost == 1 then text = "GAME OVER\n" end
for y = 0, sceneState.gridHeight - 1 do
    for x = 0, sceneState.gridWidth - 1 do
        local char = "."
        if x == sceneState.targetX and y == sceneState.targetY then
            char = "*"
        else
            for _, part in ipairs(sceneState.snake) do
                if part.x == x and part.y == y then
                    char = "O"
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        text = text .. char
    end
    text = text .. "\n"
end
sceneState.boardText = text
